name: Talbros Engineering Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1980, Talbros Engineering Ltd manufactures & sells Rear Axle Shafts[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
TEL is a part of BNT Talbros Group. It is an IATF 16949:2016, ISO 14001:2015 & ISO 45001:2018 certified manufacturer of Semi-Float and Full Float Axle Shafts for OEM’s 
in India, servicing Passenger Vehicle, Commercial Vehicle, Off-road and Tractor segments with their Light, Medium and Heavy Duty product range

cons: Debtor days have increased from 54.2 to 65.7 days.
